items.desc:
Dog Breeder Organic Shampoo is for dog owners who love to bathe, groom, and pamper their furry friends. This product is safe to use for both owners and dogs, and it keeps pets' coats and skins healthy all the time.
 
 
Gentle on the skin and prevents fur shedding with controlled pH 
Does not contain strong oxidizing agents that cause the dogs' coats to fade 
No parabens that might be harmful to pregnant dogs and puppies 
No artificial colorants/dyes that may affect the natural color of dogs' furs 
Deodorizes and naturally repels ticks and fleas 
Safe for all dog breeds and suitable for daily use 
 
Directions for Use:
 
 
Apply shampoo directly on wet fur by section (start from head to tail). 
For a more bubbly effect, 1 part shampoo may be diluted into 5 parts water. (max ratio: 1:15) 
Massage and leave on fur and skin for at least 5 minutes to allow the organic ingredients to be absorbed. 
Rinse well with water. Use a towel or blow dryer to dry fur. 
 
Notes: Use as intended. Shake well before using.

items.name: Glam Organic Adorable Angel Dog Shampoo 500mL
items.desc:
Give your furry friends a thorough wash with Glam Organic Adorable Angel Dog Shampoo! It functions as a four-in-one bath solution, so you can also use it as a conditioner, moisturizer, or cleanser. 

This product is made with a proprietary formula that is free of chemicals such as SLS, SLEs, and parabens. It contains the finest organic ingredients with luxurious blends of essential oils that will change your dog's bath experience forever.

Four-in-one bath solution

Organic-based formula

Free of harmful chemicals

Good for puppies and pregnant dogs

Shampoo: It gently removes oil from fur. The moisturizing effect of aloe vera extracts ensures that fur is rejuvenated without affecting the dog's skin.

Conditioner: It is packed with organic conditioners that help in preventing mats and aid in detangling dog fur.

Moisturizer: Unlike other brands, it contains organic moisturizers which are designed not to affect the natural pH of a dog's skin, thus, preventing skin irritation and dryness.

Cleanser: It contains pure essential oil from tea tree, which is known to naturally cleanse the skin from fungus and other skin irritations, hence a healthy supple skin.

Directions for Use:

Bush hair or coat to detangle mats and knots, then wet fur with water.

Generously pour the product. The amount consumed will depend on both the length of your dog's fur and the dog's size.

Allow the product to settle for about 2 to 3 minutes to let organic ingredients and essential oils be absorbed by fur and skin.

Rinse thoroughly with water. Dry fur with a clean towel or blow dry before combing.

 
Caution: Discontinue use if allergy occurs.
